scenario: Authenticated app with Dashboard, Insights, and Activity routes that show overlapping counts, charts, and recent events without distinct jobs.

review.summary: Navigation proliferates generic category labels. Dashboard, Insights, and Activity duplicate the same operational information instead of mapping to distinct user jobs.
alternative_constraints: Each remaining top-level route must own a distinct operator job.
Do not keep Insights or Activity if they only restate Dashboard counts.

findings.title: Dashboard, Insights, and Activity overlap
findings.observation: All three routes present run counts, a status chart, and a recent-events list. Labels do not distinguish jobs.
findings.product_mismatch: Operators need one place to watch live execution and one place to inspect a specific failure. Overlapping generic routes add navigation without a mental-model split.

evidence.fact: Each route repeats the same count strip and recent-event list with different headings.
Primary nav contains Dashboard, Insights, and Activity with no further differentiation.

findings.revision_constraint: Do not solve by restyling the nav or renaming labels without changing what each route contains.
